rename.resolution: Receive half executed 2026-09-03 alongside the `take` rename. Publish half re-homed to `c:publish_serialized_message`, which stays verdict `rename`.

why:
RE-VERDICTED 2026-09-03 (phase-379 W6 decision 1), rename -> divergence FOR THE RECEIVE HALF ONLY. ROS 2 says SERIALIZED for the pre-CDR byte form; we said RAW. The receive half moved with the `take` rename because the two words form one name: `try_recv_raw` -> `take_serialized` in C (`rclc_polling_subscription_take_serialized`), C++ (`Subscription::take_serialized`) and Rust. What remains against `rcl_take_serialized_message` is the module prefix and the `_message` suffix, both covered by `c:get_zero_initialized_publisher`'s declined precedent, plus the same byte-orientation constraint `c:take` names.
THE PUBLISH HALF IS STILL OPEN and is no longer parented here: `rclc_publish_raw` still says RAW. `c:publish_serialized_message` now carries that decision on its own.
